title: Finite étale base change for perfectoid compatible cores of pairs
difficulty_reason: The author establishes contraction by induction through the compatible-core construction using perfectoid ideal base change, and then proves the radical extension identity by passing between primes using going-down, going-up and incomparability. The source explicitly derives the latter implication as in a cited earlier positive-characteristic result, while the finite étale perfectoid setting uses the stated Bhatt–Scholze result. The definitions and source-local argument remain in the proof material.
